question: The Kullu valley with the Lahaul and Spiti valleys in Himachal Pradesh in connected by the _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohtang pass**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rohtang Pass connects the Kullu Valley with the Lahaul and Spiti Valleys of Himachal Pradesh: 
 
• The Rohtang Pass is a high mountain pass in the eastern part of the Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas, about 51 km from Manali.
 
• It is at an altitude of 3,979 m. 
 
• The Rohtang Pass links Manali and Leh by road. 
 
• The Rohtang Pass is a gateway to the Lahaul and Spiti Valley

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nathula Pass
 
• Located in the Himalayas, this pass connects Sikkim, India with Tibet, China.
 
• It's one of the highest passes that can be accessed by motor vehicles and offers views of the Himalayas.
 
• The Old Silk Route used to pass through this pass. 
 
• Bara-Lacha Pass
 
• Located in the Zanskar range, this pass connects Lahaul district in Himachal Pradesh to Leh district in Ladakh.
 
• It's one of the highest motor-able mountain passes in the region. 
 
• Mayali Pass is a high-altitude pass in the Bhilangana Valley of the Indian Himalayas
